item.title: Voltage Hysteresis Induced by Fragile Quasi‐Flat Bands in Oxygen‐Redox Cathodes
item.description:
چارچوب شبه‌باند تخت نشان می‌دهد که حساسیت حالت‌های اکسیژن 2p به اغتشاشات، هیسترزیس ولتاژ در کاتدهای ردوکس اکسیژنی باتری لیتیومی را تشدید می‌کند.
Advanced Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 This work proposes a quasi-flat-band framework explaining voltage hysteresis in oxygen-redox cathodes: oxygen 2p states near the Fermi level are intrinsically perturbation-sensitive, so weak lattice distortions or thermal vibrations amplify band dispersion and hysteresis. It reframes mitigation beyond suppressing structural reconstructions toward controlling electronic instability, offering two design principles—stabilizing symmetry and engineering orbital hybridization—to enable efficient high-voltage oxygen-redox cathodes.
🏷 oxygen-redox cathode · voltage hysteresis · quasi-flat bands · lithium battery · electronic instability

item.description:

Advanced Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty is a solvation-equilibrium-locked electrolyte using dimethyl sulfite and an ionic-liquid co-solvent, which keeps anion-rich Li⁺ solvation nearly invariant from −60 to 60 °C. This enables Li||NMC811 operation from −85 to 120 °C, pouch cells after −122.9 °C cooling, and a 565 Wh kg⁻¹ Li||Ni90 pouch cell, establishing a molecular design principle for ultrawide-temperature lithium-metal batteries.
🏷 lithium-metal battery · solvation equilibrium · ultrawide temperature · high voltage · electrolyte

item.title: Rare‐Earth‐Cluster‐Mediated Long‐Range Electronic Modulation Activates Zn Atomic Sites for Oxygen Reduction Catalysis
item.description:

Advanced Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 This work pioneers a long-range electronic regulation strategy using rare-earth oxide clusters to activate inert d10 Zn single-atom sites for ORR. The LaOx-Zn-SA/CNCl catalyst achieves a 0.90 V half-wave potential and 177.3 mW cm⁻² in zinc-air batteries, ranking among the best non-precious-metal electrocatalysts. It offers new insights into tailoring transition-metal single-atom microenvironments via rare-earth clusters for efficient electrocatalysis.
🏷 oxygen reduction · Zn single-atom · rare-earth clusters · zinc-air battery · electronic modulation

item.title: Cyclic Nonequilibrium Processing of Halide Solid Electrolytes for Low‐Pressure Operation of all‐Solid‐State Batteries
item.description:

Advanced Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 Cyclic nonequilibrium quenching of Li3InCl6 concurrently refines particles, induces local amorphization, and creates Li vacancies, boosting ionic conductivity from 1.3 to 6.8 mS/cm while lowering Young's modulus from 42.3 to 17.6 GPa. This enables all-solid-state batteries to cycle stably at only 2 MPa with 7.7 mAh/cm² areal capacity, offering a practical route to low-pressure operation.

item.title: Toward Rational Design of Aqueous Battery Membranes Beyond the Selectivity‐Conductivity Trade‐Off
item.description:
این مرور با تمرکز بر غشاهای سولفونیک اسیدی در باتری‌های جریان ردوکس، اصول طراحی برای غلبه بر مبادله رسانایی-گزینش‌پذیری و بهبود پایداری و مقیاس‌پذیری را استخراج می‌کند.
Advanced Science | ⭐ Review | 🔓 Open Access
💡 This review uniquely reframes sulfonic-acid membranes as a transferable design platform, extracting general principles beyond redox flow batteries. Its novelty lies in linking structure–transport–manufacturing relationships to overcome the conductivity–selectivity trade-off, while highlighting emerging directions like localized acid placement, biomass-derived membranes, and data-driven design. It offers significant guidance for rational, scalable membrane development across electrochemical energy-storage systems.
🏷 aqueous battery membranes · sulfonic acid membranes · redox flow batteries · ion selectivity · conductivity trade-off

item.title: Interface Rectification via Roll‐to‐Roll Dual‐Confinement Nanocoatings for High‐Temperature Polymer Capacitors
item.description:
پوشش نانولامینیت آلی-معدنی به روش roll-to-roll با محدودسازی دوگانه، تزریق حامل داغ را در خازن‌های پلیمری PEI در ۱۵۰ درجه سانتی‌گراد سرکوب کرده و چگالی انرژی و عمر را به‌شدت بهبود می‌دهد.
Advanced Science | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 Roll-to-roll dual-confinement nanocoatings introduce an interface-rectification mechanism combining polymer nanoconfinement with anisotropic carrier relaxation in nanoclay sheets. This scalable coating doubles PEI's discharged energy density at 95% efficiency, raises breakdown strength to 501 MV/m, and extends capacitor lifetime 45-fold at 150°C—enabling high-temperature, high-density polymer capacitive energy storage for wide-bandgap power electronics.
🏷 polymer capacitors · high-temperature dielectrics · nanocoatings · roll-to-roll · interface rectification
